He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets]]. He is also known as ''Wright the Right''. ==Early life== Wright grew up [[Swimming (sport)|swimming]] and playing [[tennis]]. He did not play basketball until he was entering high school. Wright attended [[Enloe High School]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]], where he played on the [[junior varsity team]] for his first two years. He competed for the Raleigh Hawks, a [[homeschooling|homeschool]] team, as a junior before making Enloe's [[varsity team]] in his senior season. He averaged 21.5 points, 13.5 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game per game as a senior.{{cite web |last1=Alexander |first1=Jonathan M. |title=He played one year of varsity basketball at Enloe. Next, he'll play at Georgia Tech |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/high-school/article158392719.html |website=[[The News & Observer]] |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=June 27, 2017}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]].{{cite web |last1=Hummer |first1=Steve |title=The ultimate late-bloomer, Moses Wright emerging as Tech leader |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/college/the-ultimate-late-bloomer-moses-wright-emerging-tech-leader/T2vdxaApILSvYmLZSKNmYP/ |website=[[The Atlanta Journal-Constitution]] |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=January 24, 2020}} He was lightly recruited by [[NCAA Division I]] programs and not ranked by major recruiting services.{{cite web |last1=Sugiura |first1=Ken |title=The story behind Georgia Tech's newest commit |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/college/the-story-behind-georgia-tech-newest-commit/RKLTGEKfn5Tan0Rg4VPUJM/ |website=[[The Atlanta Journal-Constitution]] |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=April 10, 2017}} ==College career== Wright averaged 3.6 points and 3.4 rebounds per game in his freshman season at Georgia Tech.{{cite web |last1=O'Brien |first1=Patrick |title=Junior Moses Wright (Georgia Tech) proving he belongs in the ACC |url=https://phenomhoopreport.com/junior-moses-wright-georgia-tech-proving-he-belongs-in-the-acc/ |website=Phenom Hoop Report |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=January 13, 2020}} On March 12, 2019, he recorded a sophomore season-high 25 points and seven rebounds in a 78–71 loss to [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]] at the first round of the [[2019 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]].{{cite web |title=State college basketball: Notre Dame wins ACC tourney opener |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/notre-dame/2019/03/12/notre-dame-basketball-wins-acc-tourney-opener/3144017002/ |website=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=March 12, 2019}} As a sophomore, Wright averaged 6.7 points and 3.7 rebounds per game. On February 22, 2020, he posted a career-high 33 points and 10 rebounds in a 79–72 loss to [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]].{{cite web |last1=Sugiura |first1=Ken |title=Jackets' Wright 'absolutely' candidate for ACC's most improved player |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/college/moses-wright-absolutely-candidate-for-acc-most-improved-player/h4z5gQb8ctGkolilEVMWTI/ |website=[[The Atlanta Journal-Constitution]] |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=February 24, 2020}} In his junior season, he averaged 13 points and seven rebounds per game.{{cite web |title=#5 Moses Wright, F – Men's Basketball |url=https://ramblinwreck.com/roster/moses-wright/ |website=Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets |date=June 18, 2018 |access-date=February 12, 2021}} On November 25, he registered 31 points and 20 rebounds in a 123–120 loss to [[Georgia State Panthers men's basketball|Georgia State]] in quadruple overtime.{{cite web |title=Roberts, Allen pace Georgia State's 4 OT win over Jackets |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401255625 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=February 12, 2021 |date=November 26, 2020}} On March 8, 2021, Wright was named the [[Atlantic Coast Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|ACC Player of the Year]] and first-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] for his senior season.{{cite web|url=https://theacc.com/news/2021/3/7/acc-announces-mens-basketball-awards.aspx|title=ACC Announces Men's Basketball Awards|website=theacc.com|publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference|date=March 8, 2021|access-date=March 8, 2021}} He missed the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] round of 64 game against [[Loyola Ramblers men's basketball|Loyola Chicago]] after testing positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]].{{cite web |last=Noie |first=Tom |title=Georgia Tech will face Loyola Chicago without Moses Wright, sidelined by COVID-19 |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/sports/college/2021/03/19/march-madness-georgia-tech-star-moses-wright-tests-positive-covid/4771574001/ |website=[[The Indianapolis Star]] |access-date=June 17, 2021 |date=March 19, 2021}} As a senior, he averaged 17.4 points, 8 rebounds, 2.3 assists, 1.5 steals and 1.6 blocks per game. On March 28, 2021, Wright declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]].{{cite news |last1=Marsdale |first1=Sam |title=Georgia Tech star, ACC Player of the Year Moses Wright declares for NBA Draft |url=https://247sports.com/Article/NBA-Draft-2021-Moses-Wright-declares-Georgia-Tech-Yellow-Jackets-164797962/ |access-date=September 28, 2021 |work=247 Sports |date=April 29, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===Los Angeles Clippers / Agua Caliente Clippers (2021–2022)=== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Wright joined the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]] and averaged 7.2 points, 4.4 rebounds and 1.4 blocks per game. On September 27, 2021, he signed with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].{{cite tweet|author=LA Clippers|number=1442522813173092365|title=Ready to put in work.|user=LAClippers|date=September 27, 2021|access-date=October 2, 2021}} However, he was waived on October 14.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Clippers Cut Moses Wright, George King|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/clippers-cut-moses-wright-george-king.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 14, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2021}} On October 27, Wright signed with the [[Agua Caliente Clippers]] as an affiliate player.{{cite web|title=Agua Caliente Clippers announce training camp roster for 2021–22 NBA G League season|url=https://aguacaliente.gleague.nba.com/agua-caliente-clippers-announce-training-camp-roster-for-2021-22-nba-g-league-season|publisher=National Basketball Association|date=October 27, 2021|access-date=October 31, 2021}} In 13 games, he averaged 13.5 points and 8.5 rebounds in 29.7 minutes.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Clippers Sign Moses Wright To 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/12/clippers-sign-moses-wright-to-10-day-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=December 21, 2021|access-date=December 21, 2021}} On December 21, 2021, Wright signed a ten-day contract with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]]. On December 31, 2021, Wright was reacquired and activated by the [[Agua Caliente Clippers]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|publisher=National Basketball Association|title=2021–22 NBA G League transactions|date=December 31, 2021|access-date=December 31, 2021}} ===Dallas Mavericks / Texas Legends (2021–2022)=== On February 24, 2022, Wright signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{cite magazine|url=https://www.si.com/nba/mavericks/news/dallas-mavs-sign-moses-wright-two-way-contract|magazine=Sports Illustrated|title=Mavs Sign Moses Wright to Two-Way Contract|date=February 24, 2022|access-date=February 24, 2022}} In April 2022, Wright was awarded All [[NBA G League]] First Team.{{cite web |title=2021-22 All-NBA G League, All-Rookie, and All-Defensive Teams Announced |url=https://www.slamonline.com/g-league/2021-22-all-nba-g-league-all-rookie-and-all-defensive-teams-announced/ |website=SLAM |access-date=16 October 2024 |language=en |date=19 April 2022}} ===Zheijang Golden Bulls (2022–2023)=== On July 28, 2022, Wright signed with the [[Zhejiang Golden Bulls]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].{{Cite web |last=勿忘初衷 |date=2022-07-28 |title=浙江队签约摩西-赖特 全能型内线还有一手三分 |url=https://sports.sina.com.cn/basketball/cba/2022-07-28/doc-imizirav5763317.shtml |access-date=2022-10-16 |website=sports.sina.com.cn}} In July 2023, Wright made the 2023 [[NBA Summer League]] debut for the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{cite web |title=Moses Wright makes 2023 NBA Summer League debut for the Toronto Raptors |url=https://www.si.com/college/georgiatech/basketball/moses-wright-makes-las-vegas-summer-league-debut-for-the-toronto-raptors |website=Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets On SI |access-date=16 October 2024 |date=8 July 2023}} ===Merkezefendi Belediyesi (2023–2024)=== On December 16, 2023, Wright signed with [[Merkezefendi Belediyesi Denizli Basket|Merkezefendi Belediyesi]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite web|url=https://basketfaul.com.tr/turkiye/bsl/merkezefendide-oturunun-yerine-moses-wright/|title=Merkezefendi'de Oturu'nun Yerine Moses Wright|last=|first=|date=December 16, 2023|website=|publisher=basketfaul|language=tr|access-date=December 23, 2023}} ===Olympiacos Piraeus (2024–2025)=== On January 26, 2024, Wright signed with [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]] (GBL) and the [[EuroLeague]] through the summer of 2025. On October 16, 2024, Wright received the Hoops Agents Player of the Week award for Round 2 of the domestic league, putting up a stat sheet of 23 points and 7 rebounds.{{cite web |title=Moses Wright claims Greek GBL Hoops Agents weekly honour |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Greece/news/896267/Moses-Wright-claims-Greek-GBL-Hoops-Agents-weekly-honour |website=www.eurobasket.com |access-date=16 October 2024}} On December 6, 2024, it was announced that Wright had been ruled out for the rest of the season due to unspecified health concerns. On March 25, 2025, he returned to active status in a [[EuroLeague]] match against [[ASVEL Basket]]. On June 11, 2025, Wright announced his departure from the Greek club, thanking the team and the fans for their support throughout his injury spell. ===Žalgiris Kaunas (2025–2026)=== On June 30, 2025, Wright signed one–year deal with [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] of the [[Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL) and the [[EuroLeague]].{{cite web |title=Zalgiris strengthens front line with Moses Wright |url=https://zalgiris.lt/en/naujienos/zalgiris-strengthens-front-line-with-moses-wright#article |website=zalgiris.lt |date=30 June 2025 |access-date=30 June 2025}} On February 14, 2026, Wright received a Hoops Agents Player of the Week award. He had the game-high 25 points and 6 rebounds in his team's win.{{cite web |title=Moses Wright claims Euroleague Hoops Agents weekly honour |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Euroleague/news/978338/Moses-Wright-claims-Euroleague-Hoops-Agents-weekly-honour |website=eurobasket.com |access-date=14 February 2026}} ===Olimpia Milano (2026–present)=== On July 24, 2026, Wright signed with [[Olimpia Milano]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA) and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web|title=Milan lands breakout big man Moses Wright|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/milan-lands-breakout-big-man-moses-wright/|date=July 24, 2026|website=euroleaguebasketball.net|access-date=August 18, 2026}} ==Career statistics== {{Euroleague player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Regular season==== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2021}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 Los Angeles Clippers season|L.A.
